decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established finishing portfolio, the perfect binder likely remains unless its results clearly lag aspirations, and in a growing market the firm has enough slack to keep a standard variant while covering different customer segments.
The fully automatic perfect binder fits the firm's stated move toward automation and productivity, so unless performance is visibly disappointing relative to peers it is more likely to be retained.

The booklet maker for inline and nearline use matches the firm's digital print finishing direction and complementary service capabilities, making continuation more likely than withdrawal despite limited public evidence.
